var setup=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.GetSceneManagerSetup();var lines=new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();try{foreach(var entry in UnityEditor.EditorBuildSettings.scenes.Where(e=>e.enabled&&!e.path.Contains("MainMenu"))){var scene=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.OpenScene(entry.path);int count=0,miss=0,maps=0;foreach(var map in scene.GetRootGameObjects().SelectMany(g=>g.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>())){UnityEngine.Collider2D col=map.GetComponent<UnityEngine.CompositeCollider2D>();if(col==null)col=map.GetComponent<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.TilemapCollider2D>();if(col==null)continue;maps++;var tc=map.GetComponent<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.TilemapCollider2D>();tc.ProcessTilemapChanges();UnityEngine.Physics2D.SyncTransforms();foreach(var c in map.cellBounds.allPositionsWithin)if(map.HasTile(c)&&map.GetColliderType(c)!=UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tile.ColliderType.None){count++;if(!col.OverlapPoint(map.GetCellCenterWorld(c)))miss++;}}lines.Add(scene.name+": maps="+maps+" solidCells="+count+" missing="+miss);if(miss>0)throw new System.Exception("Reload coverage failed "+scene.name);}
}finally{UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.RestoreSceneManagerSetup(setup);System.IO.File.WriteAllLines("scripts/tilemap-collision-20261110/verification.txt",lines);}return string.Join("\n",lines);
arguments.summary: Check reloaded coverage including non-composite fallback
